title: Housekeeping-entropy-production and psyche-effort nonconversion classifier
hypothesis: A typed classifier can distinguish housekeeping and excess entropy-production bookkeeping in synthetic physical models while refusing to equate either with psychological effort, moral worth, or consciousness.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate units, current, affinity, sign convention, steady-state reference, coarse-graining scope, psyche label, and claim class; inconsistent, negative, or converted rows must fail.
boundary: Structural or proxy acceptance is confined to the declared model. It does not promote empirical, participant, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or Stage 20 claims.
